item.text: {"search_note":"Search gap: I found only weak evidence of institutional durability, mostly in standardized benefit delivery and technocratic macro management. I did not find strong 2023 evidence that Putin built social institutions with genuine independence, accountability, or succession resilience. The weight of the evidence points to top-down control, politicized schools and media, captured administration, and war-driven budget priorities rather than durable institutions that would survive his personal rule.","evidence":[{"title":"More than a million families received a one-time payment at the birth of a child last year","publisher":"Social Fund of Russia","date":"2023-01-25","url":"https://sfr.gov.ru/en/press_center/~2023/01/25/250435","summary":"The birth allowance was described as due to families regardless of income or employment status, which is rule-based administration rather than personal patronage.
